description: This file is a PHP source script for rendering and processing the edit view in the Vtiger CRM module. It handles operations like retrieving entity info, setting up Smarty templates, managing form data, validation, and module-specific configurations for editing records.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Class responsible for CRM entity instances, providing factory method getInstance based on current module.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty template class used for rendering views within Vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to get a CRMEntity object corresponding to current module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab or category for the current module.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent injection attacks.

methods.name: getBasic_Advance_SearchURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for advanced search functionality.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Populates the focus object with values from HTTP request.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view mode based on focus mode.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves block information for layout in the current module and view.

methods.name: Button_Check
methods.description: Returns validation status of buttons or controls for the module.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Fetches the display name for an entity based on record ID.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Gathers update metadata information for a record.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Retrieves tab ID for the current module.

methods.name: getDBValidationData
methods.description: Fetches validation rules for database fields.

methods.name: split_validationdataArray
methods.description: Splits validation data into arrays by field properties.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Returns the sequence number field configuration for the module.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Fetches localized string for a key.

methods.name: checkModuleSeqNumber
methods.description: Checks for duplicate module sequence numbers.

methods.name: Vtiger_DependencyPicklist::getPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Fetches dependency data for picklist fields.
